S1.prompt: Find all undelivered or processing orders in orders.csv containing defective batches from the QA Batch Recall report, swap them to clean replacement batches with expedited shipping per our Refund & Replacement SOP, and email the customers their updated fulfillment details.

turn1.conflict_summary: Under Bulletin ECHO-QAB-2026-11B and SOP-REV-802 Section 4, 4 undelivered processing orders with recalled batches B-404 and B-409 qualify for pre-shipment replacement to batch B-501 and expedited shipping. However, a promotional stacking and high-value escalation conflict occurs on ORD-2026-1018 (Promo_Discount_Pct = 10) and ORD-2026-1020 (Order_Subtotal_BDT = 28,000 >= 25,000 BDT and Promo_Discount_Pct = 15), violating the Treasury 15% maximum discount ceiling and high-value order threshold when combined with complimentary expedited freight and hardware replacement.

socratic_questions.question_text: How should treasury and fulfillment resolve the pre-shipment promo-stacking and high-value escalation conflict for orders ORD-2026-1018 and ORD-2026-1020 during the B-501 batch replacement swap?

options.label: Execute B-501 Replacement Swap + Expedited Shipping & Preserve Existing Promo Discounts
options.rule_interpretation: Update all 4 qualifying undelivered recalled orders (ORD-2026-1015, ORD-2026-1017, ORD-2026-1018, ORD-2026-1020): set Batch_Code to "B-501", Shipping_Tier to "Expedited", Dispatch_Status to "Ready for Expedited Dispatch", and Refund_Status to "Replacement Swapped (B-501)" while preserving their existing Promo_Discount_Pct values unchanged (0 on ORD-2026-1015 & ORD-2026-1017, 10 on ORD-2026-1018, 15 on ORD-2026-1020). Email all 4 affected customers via the workspace recipient directory confirming their clean B-501 unit replacement and free expedited shipping upgrade under Bulletin ECHO-QAB-2026-11B.

S2.prompt: Reconcile the newly arrived inventory in the Port Receiving Manifest against open backorders in backorders_dataset.csv and update remaining available stock in products.csv according to our Allocation Priority Policy, then notify affected backorder buyers by email.

turn1.conflict_summary: Cross-catalog inventory reconciliation between backorders_dataset.csv and products.csv triggers a Storefront Buffer Deficit conflict under SOP-OPS-019 Section 4. Specifically, Port Receiving Manifest PRM-2026-1104-CTG yielded 40 net passed units for SKU VL-POLO-BLK ('Classic Short-Sleeve Polo'). Combined with existing storefront stock of 24 units in products.csv (size: {'M':4,'L':8,'XL':8,'XXL':4}), the total available pool is 64 units. However, fulfilling all 60 units of open Pending backorders across rows BO-2001, BO-2002, BO-2004, BO-2006, BO-2009, and BO-2013 would leave only 4 units in storefront stock—violating the mandatory 10-unit Minimum Storefront Buffer Rule by 6 units. Operator selection is required between prioritizing 100% backorder fulfillment (leaving 4 units in products.csv) or enforcing the 10-unit storefront buffer first (allocating 54 surplus units to backorders).

socratic_questions.question_text: How should the system resolve the 64 combined units pool between open Pending backorders for 'Classic Short-Sleeve Polo' and the mandatory 10-unit Minimum Storefront Buffer in products.csv?

S3.prompt: Audit all wholesale accounts in wholesale_accunts_dataset.csv with overdue balances, enforce the required credit limit reductions and account holds per our Finance Credit Control Policy while factoring in Q4 VIP Expansion retention rules, and email the account contacts.

turn1.conflict_summary: An Overdue Receivables Audit per FIN-POL-008 Section 5 identifies exactly 5 accounts with overdue_balance > 0: ACC-1004, ACC-1007, ACC-1008, ACC-1009, and ACC-1016. Under strict credit control, all 5 accounts are subject to a mandatory 25% credit limit cut and 'Credit Hold' status. However, ACC-1004 (annual_spend = 16,200 >= 15,000) and ACC-1007 (Gold tier, annual_spend = 34,000 >= 15,000) qualify for protection under the Q4 VIP Retention Protection Clause (DIR-COM-2026-Q4 Section 5), creating a policy conflict between Option 1 (No VIP Exemption; strict -25% cut and Credit Hold on all 5 accounts) and Option 2 (Apply Q4 VIP 14-Day Retention Grace Rule to ACC-1004 & ACC-1007; enforce strict -25% cut & Credit Hold on standard overdue accounts ACC-1008, ACC-1009, & ACC-1016).

socratic_questions.question_text: How should the system handle the Overdue Receivables Audit for high-value and Gold tier accounts that carry overdue balances in conflict with standard underwriting credit hold rules?

options.label: Option 1 (Enforce Strict Finance Credit Control Policy Across All 5 Overdue Accounts -- No VIP Exemption)
options.rule_interpretation: Reduce credit_limit by 25% and set account_status = "Credit Hold" on all 5 overdue accounts: ACC-1004 (credit_limit: 10000 -> 7500, account_status: "Active" -> "Credit Hold"), ACC-1007 (credit_limit: 25000 -> 18750, account_status: "Active" -> "Credit Hold"), ACC-1008 (credit_limit: 3500 -> 2625, account_status: "Active" -> "Credit Hold"), ACC-1009 (credit_limit: 7200 -> 5400, account_status: "Active" -> "Credit Hold"), and ACC-1016 (credit_limit: 2500 -> 1875, account_status: "Active" -> "Credit Hold"). Dispatch formal Credit Hold and 25% credit reduction notification emails to all 5 Account Managers (David Chen, Tariq Al-Mansoor, Chloe Bennett, Priya Nair, Nathan Brooks) addressing them by name, company name, account id, updated credit limit, and account status.

options.label: Option 2 (Apply Q4 VIP 14-Day Retention Grace Rule to High-Spend/Gold Accounts ACC-1004 & ACC-1007; Enforce Strict -25% Cut & Credit Hold on Standard Overdue Accounts ACC-1008, ACC-1009, ACC-1016)
options.rule_interpretation: For standard overdue accounts ACC-1008, ACC-1009, and ACC-1016: reduce credit_limit by 25% (ACC-1008: 3500 -> 2625; ACC-1009: 7200 -> 5400; ACC-1016: 2500 -> 1875) and set account_status = "Credit Hold" ("Active" -> "Credit Hold"). For VIP Retention protected accounts ACC-1004 and ACC-1007: preserve their existing credit_limit (0% cut: ACC-1004 stays at 10000, ACC-1007 stays at 25000) and set account_status = "Retention Grace (14-Day)" ("Active" -> "Retention Grace (14-Day)"). Dispatch a 14-day split-settlement retention notice to Account Managers David Chen (ACC-1004) and Tariq Al-Mansoor (ACC-1007) alongside formal Credit Hold and credit reduction notices to Chloe Bennett (ACC-1008), Priya Nair (ACC-1009), and Nathan Brooks (ACC-1016), referencing each partner's company name, account id, tier, credit limit, and account status.
